$comment: APIM products = consumer tiers. Each product carries a subscription and (optionally) product-scoped policy. Tier-specific token limits are supplied as named values referenced by the token-limit fragment. Product approval is off for demo convenience.

products.name: free
products.description: Free tier: low token rate limit, low daily quota, Fast model only, semantic cache on, low completion ceiling.

products.name: standard
products.description: Standard tier: medium limits/quota, Fast + Balanced models, semantic cache on, higher completion ceiling.

products.name: premium
products.description: Premium tier: high limits/quota, all models, priority backend access, optional cache bypass, highest completion ceiling.
